newsitem.title: UK: European cotton sees light prompt demand.
newsitem.headline: European cotton sees light prompt demand.

text.p: With some mills already on holiday, and many others preparing to close for the summer break, demand on most European raw cotton markets has been predictably slow.
One or two gap-filling transaction have been arranged for prompt delivery ex-merchant's holdings, but business generally has been lacking in new feature.
Forward demand has remained of a very tentative nature, in face of the rather uncertain outlook for yarn and textile sales, and the prevailing firmness of the trade's price ideas.
